summary: Iteration 35 full-stack verification of the 4 retreat deliverables (admin photo uploads to Emergent object storage, guest cancel + 60-day refund rule, waitlist 48h seat-offer expiry, month+year date display) plus regressions. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration35.py) — admin upload returns {url,path}, /api/files/{path} serves HTTP 200 image/png with byte-identical content, non-admin=403, anonymous=401, non-image=400, unknown file=404; cancel returns refund_pending (>=60d + paid), non_refundable (<60d + paid), not_applicable (unpaid), 400 on repeat, 403 for another user's reservation, 404 unknown, 401 unauthenticated; cancel promotes next waitlister to seat_offered with a fresh 48h window; the 60s background loop's expire_seat_offers_tick() flipped an expired seat_offered row to offer_expired and promoted the next waitlister with a fresh ~48h expiry; seeded retreat starts 2026-12-01; no _id leaks. Auth playbook verified: bcrypt $2b$ hashes, httpOnly access_token cookie on login, brute-force 429 after 5 failures, seed_admin re-hashes on password change, /auth/me strips password_hash. Frontend (mobile 390x844): admin Console -> Retreats upload control uploads a PNG (POST /api/admin/uploads 200), renders a real (non-broken) thumbnail served from /api/files/..., syncs the URL into the paste-URL textarea, paste-URL entry still adds previews and remove works; Profile cancel dialog shows days-until-start plus the correct refundable / non-refundable / no-payment note, confirm calls the API and the row updates to 'Cancelled · refund pending' / 'Cancelled · non-refundable' with the cancel button hidden, 'Keep my seat' dismisses without cancelling; pay-balance button renders for deposit_paid; WorkshopDetail shows the claim-seat button with '(48h left)' countdown; Marketing card, WorkshopDetail Dates card and Profile all render 'December 2026' (month+year only). No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: Uses the blocking `requests` library inside async endpoints (init_storage/_put_object/_get_object), which blocks the FastAPI event loop for the duration of every upload/serve (up to the 120s timeout). Should use httpx.AsyncClient or starlette.concurrency.run_in_threadpool.
No max file-size guard — a large image is read fully into memory (`await file.read()`) and pushed to object storage; add a size cap (e.g. 10 MB) and return 413.
Removing a photo from a retreat gallery leaves the object and its uploaded_files row orphaned in storage (slow storage leak); no cleanup/soft-delete path is exercised anywhere.

CORSMiddleware is configured with allow_credentials=False while /auth/login sets an httpOnly access_token cookie — cookie-based auth would silently fail from any other origin. Currently harmless because the SPA is same-origin and uses Bearer tokens, but the playbook expects allow_credentials=True with explicit origins.

ui_bugs.issue: The per-photo remove button is `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`, so on touch devices (the console is a mobile-first layout) it is invisible and effectively unreachable — Playwright needed force=True to click it. Make it always visible on small screens.

design_issues.screen: Admin Console → Retreats → Publish a retreat
issues: Start/End date use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder) instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker used elsewhere — inconsistent with the design system and locale-confusing.
Dialog has square corners on mobile (ui/alert-dialog.jsx applies `sm:rounded-lg` only) while the whole app uses rounded-2xl cards — visually off at 390px width.

action_items: Make the gallery photo remove (×) button visible without hover on touch/mobile widths.
Replace blocking `requests` calls in routers/uploads.py with async HTTP (httpx) or run_in_threadpool, and add an upload size limit.
Optional: swap the admin retreat Start/End native date inputs for the shadcn date picker; round the AlertDialog corners on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/uploads.py performs synchronous network I/O (requests.post/put/get) inside async def handlers — every upload and every public image fetch blocks the single event loop; this will visibly stall the whole API under concurrent gallery loads.

routers/retreats.py: module-level `_logger` is defined at line ~280, after _promote_waitlist/expire_seat_offers_tick reference it; it works at runtime but should be declared at the top of the module with the other imports.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx is 1911 lines — split each pane (RetreatsPane, SettingsPane, …) into its own module.
uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend/tests, so editing test files restarts the backend and resets the 60s background loop; consider excluding the tests dir from reload watching.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (upload, cancel+refund both branches, dismiss, claim-seat countdown, month+year dates, pay-balance render)

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in this iteration's features. The only real UI defect is the hover-only gallery remove button (CSS opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 has no touch equivalent). The apparent 'transparent dialog' seen in an early screenshot was an artifact of capturing mid fade-in animation, not a styling bug — confirmed by computed styles.
